caption:
Comment "JARVIS" and I'll send you the free resources.

My AI runs entirely on my own computer, and it just took apart an award-winning website 👀

I said one sentence: "Jarvis, reverse engineer igloo.inc."

It opened a clean browser, scrolled the whole site by itself and told me exactly how it's built: one full-screen Three.js scene inside a small Svelte shell, GSAP driving the motion, bloom and depth of field on top. The surprise? The whole page is only one screen tall.

And it's not hacking. Everything it reads is already public in Chrome's developer tools.

Next step: tell Jarvis to rebuild it.

Comment JARVIS and I'll send you the free resources.
